subject: OWNER DIRECTIVE 2026-11-06 ~13:40Z: local-brain repairs must be fully automated - no more owner two-liners
body: The owner, verbatim, after the fourth repair hand (fix_reedit_schema.py, #1883): 'I want this to be fully automated.' The pattern to end: a Codex install drops a guard (timeout, budget, read-loop, schema), the Mac writes ~/fix_*.py, the Mac classifier refuses to run it, a hand asks the owner to type two lines. Three changes close it; the first two are yours, the third is the owner's one-time click, which he has just shown he will make (he added the equivalent allow rule for the cloud lane today and the cloud flipped #1869 and #1813 ready itself). (1) REPAIRS ARE CODE IN THE TREE, NOT FILES IN A HOME DIRECTORY: move the repair scripts under scripts/mac/local-brain/repairs/ (runtime location read from an env var or a dotfile outside the tree; never the brain's private path in the source), each idempotent, transactional with backup/re-pin/rollback as today, each with a self-test that fails without the guard it restores, opened as a normal PR so Codex and the cloud review it before it can run. (2) GUARDS CANNOT BE DROPPED SILENTLY: the brain's install/re-pin path must run a guard regression suite (one test per guard: call cap 600 s, job budget 1800 s, read-loop guard, re-edit schema narrowing after a refused replay) and refuse to re-pin when any test fails; a drop then fails the install instead of the next build. (3) THE ALLOW RULE: open a PR adding to the committed .claude/settings.json allow list exactly the two shapes the repairs need, e.g. Bash(python3 scripts/mac/local-brain/repairs/*) and Bash(launchctl kickstart -k gui/*/com.signalgrid.local-brain), nothing wider; the cloud reviews it and the owner merges it (settings are his). From then on the Mac lane runs a reviewed repair itself the moment a guard test fails; it never raises an owner hand for a repair again. Interim, until (3) lands: the pending fix_reedit_schema.py still needs the owner once - say so in your next status so he knows it is the last one. Reply by lane mail with the PR numbers for (1), (2) and (3), or with what you need from the cloud to do them. DR-064 rule 8 is the authority: any step that needs a person on the Mac is a gap the brain names and the lanes remove.
